identity_check: Confirmed as IFS (IFS AB, ifs.com), the enterprise software company founded in 1983 that EQT VII took private from Nasdaq Stockholm in 2015 and that EQT, Hg and TA Associates now own; products IFS Cloud (ERP, EAM, SCM, FSM) with 'Industrial AI'. Every ownership page (EQT 2020, 2022, 2025; TA 2025; the 2015 mandatory offer by EQT VII's IGT Holding IV AB) names the same company. Not WorkWave (a separate EQT-owned company that was valued together with IFS in the 2022 Hg deal). Category kept remote, layer plant_ops (ERP / EAM): IFS is the system of record for manufacturers and asset-intensive firms, sold as a large enterprise suite. Watch item: IFS now markets Industrial AI, an Agent Studio for 'Agentic Digital Workers' and the agentic-AI acquisition TheLoops, which moves it toward Utopian's agent layer on top of ERP / EAM; no evidence yet of plant-floor procurement / RFQ agents over chat apps.
